title: Margaret Thatcher - "They'd rather have the poor poorer."
summary: A short clip of Margaret Thatcher in Parliament in 1990 arguing that economic reforms benefited everyone even as the rich-poor gap widened. She says her opponents would rather the poor be poorer if it meant the rich were less rich.
why: Commenters link it as a shorthand for an argument about inequality, absolute versus relative prosperity, quoting her line in threads about taxes and wealth.

quote.text: Thatcher had famously summarized the inequality argument here
